## Review
I didn't have high expectations.  
A movie that overcame an experimental exorcism theme and lack of fun elements in Korea through casting.  

There seem to be hidden details, such as taxi numbers or contrasting light and darkness, but I didn't delve deep into it as it's a world I don't know well.  

The genre of this movie is <mark>Kang Dong-won</mark>.
